name: @avatark/world-experience-runtime
description: Executes Build 04's World Experience layer: pure arrival-decision resolution, canonical-event-scope-to-LocationId resolution, and Place Continuity / Orientation / World Experience Snapshot composition -- all pure functions over already-resolved contract shapes, never a second causal engine and never a query against simulation/persistence internals itself (the Host layer resolves those; this package only recombines their outputs). Host-neutral, database-neutral, franchise-neutral, matching every sibling *-runtime package's own discipline.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/arrivalDecision.test.ts src/canonicalScope.test.ts src/placeContinuity.test.ts src/orientation.test.ts src/worldExperienceSnapshot.test.ts src/livingForestExperiencePortability.test.ts
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
